summary.name: Blueprint Drafting Animation
summary.visualIdentity: Flat #1B3ED2 blueprint field with white grid, dimension lines, dashed hidden edges, and 45° section hatching. Labels show real measured dimensions in a technical face.
summary.suitableUses: Explicit: measured, dimension-led technical explainers of parts. Inferred: engineering or architectural explainers. Subject, audience, and scenes are unspecified.
summary.limitations: Dense hatching can alias at 1080p. The 7.876 white-on-blue check excludes textures and video compositing. Simulations are not validated physics. Sketch treatments would undermine measured precision.
summary.palette: Source-evidenced #1B3ED2 field and #FFFFFF text, no gradient. Policy is scene_dependent, yet the visual cues fix the blue field; keep it unless the task supplies an approved palette. Never transfer the poster's cream PAPER stage.
summary.motionAndInteraction: One paused GSAP timeline: grid fades in, outlines and hidden edges draw, hatch wipes in, then dimension shafts draw inward. Arrowheads appear at shaft completion, labels after. No interaction or motion reference is specified.
summary.audio: No audio is supplied or mandated. Suggested: optional music, voiceover, effects, or silence fitted to topic and audience. Music must not compete with speech or reading holds; effects may mark line completions.
summary.assetRequirements: No uploads are mandatory. Needed: a measured geometry spec from which dimensions and labels are computed, plus local technical fonts. The source poster is optional reference only; no motion-reference candidates exist.
summary.combinations: Keep style-116 dominant. Optional style-109 adds precise contour reveals only, without its palette or background. Optional tools: p5.js for evolving curves, Cytoscape.js for node-edge graphs, Anime.js for line reveals. Avoid competing full-scene treatments.
summary.productionApproach: SVG and HTML/CSS render visuals; GSAP with DrawSVGPlugin owns motion. HyperFrames is the default pipeline; Remotion only if HyperFrames is unavailable. Verify forward, backward, and direct seeks at head-switch times, and inspect decoded frames.
